08/18/2023: Station Retired                                             [0000] 
  
            - station retired 
               - station now being managed by Wisconet (Wisconsin Mesonet)... 
                  ...for more information and current data, refer to: 
 
                        https://wisconet.wisc.edu 
                        https://wisconet.wisc.edu/stations/sister_bay
